cohort: Women who underwent MBS and subsequently became pregnant
finding: Women with a preconception BMI ≥ 30 kg/m(2) after MBS had significantly lower gestational weight gain but higher neonatal intensive care unit admissions compared to those with a preconception BMI < 30 kg/m(2).
mod_finding: The study found no statistically significant differences in the mode of delivery between women with a pre-conception BMI < 30 kg/m(2) and those with a pre-conception BMI ≥ 30 kg/m(2) after metabolic and bariatric surgery.
